# Overview

This R Markdown document performs the complete IGARCH analysis pipeline for Chapter 4:

1. **IGARCH(1,1) parameter estimation** (baseline, no sentiment)
2. **IGARCH-X(1,1) parameter estimation** (sentiment-augmented)
3. **Walk-forward 1-step-ahead variance forecasts** (all four IGARCH variants)
4. **Residual diagnostics** (Ljung-Box tests on standardized residuals)

**Output files** (imported by Python notebook):
- `igarch_params_from_r.csv` → IGARCH baseline parameters
- `igarchx_params_from_r.csv` → IGARCH-X sentiment parameters
- `igarch_oos_forecasts_from_r.csv` → OOS forecasts (all models)
- `igarch_diag_from_r.csv` → Baseline IGARCH diagnostics
- `igarchx_diag_from_r.csv` → Sentiment IGARCH-X diagnostics

# Setup & Data Loading

## Install / Load Packages

```{r load-packages}
# 1) Use a reliable mirror
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

# 2) Remove any partially downloaded packages (temp folder)
unlink(file.path(tempdir(), "downloaded_packages"), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

# 3) Increase timeout (prevents partial downloads)
options(timeout = 600)

# 4) Try installing the failing dependency explicitly as a binary
install.packages("mclust", type = "binary")

# 5) Then install rugarch (and your others)
install.packages(c("rugarch", "readr", "dplyr"), type = "binary")

options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"), timeout = 600)

pkgs <- c("rugarch", "readr", "dplyr")
to_install <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())]

if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install, type = "binary")
invisible(lapply(pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))

options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"), timeout = 600)
install.packages("mclust", type = "source")

```

## Load and Prepare Data

```{r load-data}
# ---- Data path (adjust if needed) ----
DATA_PATH <- "../Data/final_data.csv"

# ---- Load ----
df <- read_csv(DATA_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)

# ---- Date parsing: dd/mm/yyyy format ----
# If your dates are in dd/mm/yyyy, use this:
df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")

# Sanity check
if (any(is.na(df$Date))) {
  stop("Date parsing failed. Check date format.")
}

# ---- Sort by date ----
df <- df[order(df$Date), ]

# ---- Standardize sentiment column name ----
if ("Trends" %in% names(df) && !("Search_Interest" %in% names(df))) {
  df$Search_Interest <- df$Trends
}

# ---- Compute log returns (percent) ----
df$r <- 100 * (log(df$Close) - log(dplyr::lag(df$Close)))
df <- df[!is.na(df$r), ]

# ---- Report ----
N <- nrow(df)
cat("Data loaded successfully.\n")
cat("Date range:", as.character(min(df$Date)), "→", as.character(max(df$Date)), "\n")
cat("Observations (after returns):", N, "\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
```

---

# Section 1: IGARCH(1,1) Parameter Estimation

## Specify Models

```{r igarch-spec}
r <- df$r

# Baseline IGARCH with Normal innovations
spec_igarch_norm <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    model = "iGARCH",
    garchOrder = c(1, 1)
  ),
  mean.model = list(
    armaOrder = c(0, 0),
    include.mean = TRUE
  ),
  distribution.model = "norm"
)

# Baseline IGARCH with Student-t innovations
spec_igarch_std <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    model = "iGARCH",
    garchOrder = c(1, 1)
  ),
  mean.model = list(
    armaOrder = c(0, 0),
    include.mean = TRUE
  ),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

cat("IGARCH model specifications created.\n")
```

## Estimate Models

```{r igarch-fit}
# Fit IGARCH with Normal innovations
fit_igarch_norm <- ugarchfit(
  spec = spec_igarch_norm,
  data = r,
  solver = "solnp",
  fit.control = list(eval.se = TRUE)
)

# Fit IGARCH with Student-t innovations
fit_igarch_std <- ugarchfit(
  spec = spec_igarch_std,
  data = r,
  solver = "solnp",
  fit.control = list(eval.se = TRUE)
)

cat("IGARCH models fitted successfully.\n")
cat("Solver:", "solnp", "\n\n")
```

## Extract and Export IGARCH Parameters

```{r igarch-params}
# Extract coefficients
params_igarch_norm <- coef(fit_igarch_norm)
params_igarch_std <- coef(fit_igarch_std)

# Create unified parameter table
all_params <- sort(unique(c(names(params_igarch_norm), names(params_igarch_std))))

igarch_params <- data.frame(
  param = all_params,
  IGARCH_Normal = as.numeric(params_igarch_norm[all_params]),
  IGARCH_Student_t = as.numeric(params_igarch_std[all_params])
)

# Add log-likelihood (useful metric)
ll_row <- data.frame(
  param = "loglik",
  IGARCH_Normal = likelihood(fit_igarch_norm),
  IGARCH_Student_t = likelihood(fit_igarch_std)
)

igarch_params <- rbind(igarch_params, ll_row)

# Display
cat("IGARCH Parameters:\n\n")
print(igarch_params)

# Create igarch subdirectory if needed
if (!dir.exists("igarch")) {
  dir.create("igarch", showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Export to CSV
write_csv(igarch_params, "igarch/igarch_params_from_r.csv")
cat("\n✓ Saved: igarch/igarch_params_from_r.csv\n")
```

# Section 2: IGARCH-X(1,1) Parameter Estimation (with Sentiment)

## Prepare External Regressors

```{r igarchx-prep}
# External regressor: sentiment in variance equation
x_sent <- as.matrix(df$Search_Interest)

cat("External regressor (sentiment) prepared.\n")
cat("Observations:", nrow(x_sent), "\n")
cat("Regressor summary:\n")
print(summary(as.numeric(x_sent)))
```

## Specify IGARCH-X Models

```{r igarchx-spec}
# IGARCH-X with Normal innovations
spec_igarchx_norm <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    model = "iGARCH",
    garchOrder = c(1, 1),
    external.regressors = x_sent
  ),
  mean.model = list(
    armaOrder = c(0, 0),
    include.mean = TRUE
  ),
  distribution.model = "norm"
)

# IGARCH-X with Student-t innovations
spec_igarchx_std <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    model = "iGARCH",
    garchOrder = c(1, 1),
    external.regressors = x_sent
  ),
  mean.model = list(
    armaOrder = c(0, 0),
    include.mean = TRUE
  ),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

cat("IGARCH-X model specifications created.\n")
```

## Estimate IGARCH-X Models

```{r igarchx-fit}
# Fit IGARCH-X with Normal innovations
fit_igarchx_norm <- ugarchfit(
  spec = spec_igarchx_norm,
  data = r,
  solver = "solnp",
  fit.control = list(eval.se = TRUE)
)

# Fit IGARCH-X with Student-t innovations
fit_igarchx_std <- ugarchfit(
  spec = spec_igarchx_std,
  data = r,
  solver = "solnp",
  fit.control = list(eval.se = TRUE)
)

cat("IGARCH-X models fitted successfully.\n")
```

## Extract and Export IGARCH-X Parameters

```{r igarchx-params}
# Extract coefficients
params_igarchx_norm <- coef(fit_igarchx_norm)
params_igarchx_std <- coef(fit_igarchx_std)

# Create unified parameter table
all_params_x <- sort(unique(c(names(params_igarchx_norm), names(params_igarchx_std))))

igarchx_params <- data.frame(
  param = all_params_x,
  IGARCHX_Normal = as.numeric(params_igarchx_norm[all_params_x]),
  IGARCHX_Student_t = as.numeric(params_igarchx_std[all_params_x])
)

# Add log-likelihood
ll_row_x <- data.frame(
  param = "loglik",
  IGARCHX_Normal = likelihood(fit_igarchx_norm),
  IGARCHX_Student_t = likelihood(fit_igarchx_std)
)

igarchx_params <- rbind(igarchx_params, ll_row_x)

# Display
cat("IGARCH-X Parameters:\n\n")
print(igarchx_params)

# Export to CSV
write_csv(igarchx_params, "igarch/igarchx_params_from_r.csv")
cat("\n✓ Saved: igarch/igarchx_params_from_r.csv\n")
```

# Section 3: Walk-Forward Forecasting

## Settings (must match Python notebook)

```{r forecast-settings}
# ---- Match these with your Python notebook (Cell 2 config) ----
TEST_SIZE <- 0.20
ROLLING_WINDOW <- 750  # Set to NA for expanding window
LAGS <- c(10, 20)

# ---- Compute split index ----
split_idx <- floor((1 - TEST_SIZE) * N)
n_oos <- N - split_idx
oos_dates <- df$Date[(split_idx + 1):N]

cat("Forecast Settings:\n")
cat("  TEST_SIZE:", TEST_SIZE, "\n")
cat("  ROLLING_WINDOW:", ROLLING_WINDOW, "\n")
cat("  In-sample size:", split_idx, "\n")
cat("  Out-of-sample size:", n_oos, "\n")
cat("  OOS period:", as.character(min(oos_dates)), "→", as.character(max(oos_dates)), "\n\n")
```

## 1-Step Variance Forecast Function

```{r forecast-function}
# ---- Helper function: 1-step variance forecast ----
one_step_var_forecast <- function(
  spec,
  t_idx,
  use_external = FALSE,
  window_length = NULL
) {
  # Define estimation window
  end_est <- t_idx - 1
  
  if (is.na(window_length) || is.null(window_length)) {
    start_est <- 1  # Expanding window
  } else {
    start_est <- max(1, end_est - window_length + 1)  # Rolling window
  }
  
  # Extract data for estimation
  r_est <- df$r[start_est:end_est]
  
  if (use_external) {
    # For external regressor models
    x_est <- as.matrix(df$Search_Interest[start_est:end_est])
    
    # Fit model on windowed data
    fit <- ugarchfit(
      spec = spec,
      data = r_est,
      solver = "solnp"
    )
    
    # Next-period external regressor (for variance forecast)
    x_next <- matrix(df$Search_Interest[t_idx], nrow = 1, ncol = 1)
    
    # 1-step ahead variance forecast
    fc <- ugarchforecast(
      fit,
      n.ahead = 1,
      external.forecasts = list(vregfor = x_next)
    )
  } else {
    # For baseline models (no external regressor)
    fit <- ugarchfit(
      spec = spec,
      data = r_est,
      solver = "solnp"
    )
    
    # 1-step ahead variance forecast
    fc <- ugarchforecast(fit, n.ahead = 1)
  }
  
  # Extract and return variance forecast (h_t = σ_t^2)
  as.numeric(sigma(fc)^2)[1]
}

cat("Forecast function defined.\n\n")
```

## Generate Walk-Forward Forecasts

```{r forecast-generate}
# ---- Initialize forecast vectors ----
f_igarch_norm  <- numeric(n_oos)
f_igarch_std   <- numeric(n_oos)
f_igarchx_norm <- numeric(n_oos)
f_igarchx_std  <- numeric(n_oos)

# ---- Walk-forward loop ----
cat("Generating forecasts (this may take a few minutes)...\n")

idx_forecast <- (split_idx + 1):N

for (i in seq_along(idx_forecast)) {
  t_idx <- idx_forecast[i]
  
  # IGARCH baseline
  f_igarch_norm[i] <- one_step_var_forecast(
    spec_igarch_norm,
    t_idx,
    use_external = FALSE,
    window_length = ROLLING_WINDOW
  )
  
  f_igarch_std[i] <- one_step_var_forecast(
    spec_igarch_std,
    t_idx,
    use_external = FALSE,
    window_length = ROLLING_WINDOW
  )
  
  # IGARCH-X sentiment-augmented
  f_igarchx_norm[i] <- one_step_var_forecast(
    spec_igarchx_norm,
    t_idx,
    use_external = TRUE,
    window_length = ROLLING_WINDOW
  )
  
  f_igarchx_std[i] <- one_step_var_forecast(
    spec_igarchx_std,
    t_idx,
    use_external = TRUE,
    window_length = ROLLING_WINDOW
  )
  
  # Progress indicator
  if (i %% 50 == 0) {
    cat("  Completed:", i, "of", n_oos, "\n")
  }
}

cat("✓ Forecasts generated.\n\n")
```

## Export OOS Forecasts

```{r forecast-export}
# ---- Create forecast data frame ----
forecasts_oos <- data.frame(
  Date = oos_dates,
  IGARCH_Normal = f_igarch_norm,
  IGARCH_Student_t = f_igarch_std,
  IGARCHX_Normal = f_igarchx_norm,
  IGARCHX_Student_t = f_igarchx_std
)

# ---- Format dates as ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) for Python compatibility ----
forecasts_oos$Date <- format(as.Date(forecasts_oos$Date), "%Y-%m-%d")

# Display first and last rows
cat("Forecast Summary:\n")
cat("First 5 forecasts:\n")
print(head(forecasts_oos))
cat("\nLast 5 forecasts:\n")
print(tail(forecasts_oos))

# ---- Export to CSV ----
write_csv(forecasts_oos, "igarch/igarch_oos_forecasts_from_r.csv")
cat("\n✓ Saved: igarch/igarch_oos_forecasts_from_r.csv\n")
```

# Section 4: Residual Diagnostics

## Ljung-Box Test Helper

```{r diagnostics-helper}
# ---- Helper function: Ljung-Box diagnostics ----
ljung_box_diagnostics <- function(fit, lags = c(10, 20), model_name = "") {
  # Extract standardized residuals
  z <- residuals(fit, standardize = TRUE)
  z <- as.numeric(z[is.finite(z)])
  
  # Initialize output data frame
  out <- data.frame(
    lag = lags,
    lb_stat_resid = NA_real_,
    lb_pvalue_resid = NA_real_,
    lb_stat_sqresid = NA_real_,
    lb_pvalue_sqresid = NA_real_,
    Model = model_name
  )
  
  # Compute Ljung-Box for each lag
  for (i in seq_along(lags)) {
    L <- lags[i]
    
    # Test on residuals
    bt_resid <- Box.test(z, lag = L, type = "Ljung-Box")
    out$lb_stat_resid[i] <- unname(bt_resid$statistic)
    out$lb_pvalue_resid[i] <- unname(bt_resid$p.value)
    
    # Test on squared residuals
    bt_sqresid <- Box.test(z^2, lag = L, type = "Ljung-Box")
    out$lb_stat_sqresid[i] <- unname(bt_sqresid$statistic)
    out$lb_pvalue_sqresid[i] <- unname(bt_sqresid$p.value)
  }
  
  out
}

cat("Ljung-Box diagnostics function defined.\n\n")
```

## IGARCH Baseline Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics-igarch}
# ---- Compute diagnostics for baseline IGARCH models ----
diag_igarch_norm <- ljung_box_diagnostics(
  fit_igarch_norm,
  lags = LAGS,
  model_name = "IGARCH-Normal"
)

diag_igarch_std <- ljung_box_diagnostics(
  fit_igarch_std,
  lags = LAGS,
  model_name = "IGARCH-Student-t"
)

# ---- Combine ----
diag_igarch <- rbind(diag_igarch_norm, diag_igarch_std)

# Display
cat("IGARCH Baseline Diagnostics (Ljung-Box):\n\n")
print(diag_igarch)

# Export
write_csv(diag_igarch, "igarch/igarch_diag_from_r.csv")
cat("\n✓ Saved: igarch/igarch_diag_from_r.csv\n")
```

## IGARCH-X Sentiment Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics-igarchx}
# ---- Compute diagnostics for sentiment IGARCH-X models ----
diag_igarchx_norm <- ljung_box_diagnostics(
  fit_igarchx_norm,
  lags = LAGS,
  model_name = "IGARCH-X Normal"
)

diag_igarchx_std <- ljung_box_diagnostics(
  fit_igarchx_std,
  lags = LAGS,
  model_name = "IGARCH-X Student-t"
)

# ---- Combine ----
diag_igarchx <- rbind(diag_igarchx_norm, diag_igarchx_std)

# Display
cat("IGARCH-X Sentiment Diagnostics (Ljung-Box):\n\n")
print(diag_igarchx)

# Export
write_csv(diag_igarchx, "igarch/igarchx_diag_from_r.csv")
cat("\n✓ Saved: igarch/igarchx_diag_from_r.csv\n")
```
